question: Which of the following was the first operating system written in 'C' language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UNIX**__.

__
 
• UNIX is an** operating system **that was first developed in the 1960s
 
• Operating system, we mean the suite of programs which make the computer work.
 
• The operating system is a stable, multi-user, multi-tasking system for servers, desktops and laptops.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• UNIX is an operating system that was original **AT&T.**
 
• UNIX development started in **1969** at the **Bell Labs research centre** by **Ken Thompson**, **Dennis Ritchie.**
 
• UNIX was widely used for ** Internet servers**, **workstations**, and **mainframe computers**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Windows 10** is a major release of** Microsoft's** Windows NT operating system.
 
• **Xenix** is a discontinued version of the Unix operating system for various microcomputer platforms, licensed by Microsoft from **AT&T **Corporation in the late **1970s**
 
• **Linux** is an open-source multi-tasking, multi-user operating system.
